subject: Kickoff: Quality monitoring & continuity plan for Helix Health integration
messages:
From: Asha Rao <asha@helixhealth.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Quality monitoring & continuity plan for Helix Health integration

Hi Rishi + Monica,

Thanks for the demo last week — Helix is ready to move from pilot to a staged production rollout and we need Redwood's help to set up quality monitoring. High-level asks:

- Integrate our prompt sets and existing regression suites into Redwood's eval harness.
- Establish canary and rollback policies so new model or prompt changes don't degrade clinical suggestions.
- Configure regression alerts and weekly quality reports we can share with product/clinical leads.

We attached our baseline requirements spreadsheet for scope. Can we get a proposed staging plan and high-level timeline? Ideally the first canary (5% traffic) goes live within 3 weeks.

Attachments: Helix_QMon_Reqs.xlsx (xlsx)

Asha Rao
Head of Data Products
Helix Health
asha@helixhealth.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Quality monitoring & continuity plan for Helix Health integration

Asha — thanks for the clear brief and the attachment. Draft proposal below (short form); I'll follow up with a formal staging doc + calendar invite for a 30-min sync.

Staged quality continuity plan (proposed):
1) Week 0 (kickoff): align on prompt set canonicalization, map prompt IDs to eval suites, confirm success thresholds (precision/recall/clinical safety flags).
2) Week 1: Eval harness integration — ingest Helix prompt sets, run baseline regression sweep, produce baseline quality report and expected variance bands.
3) Week 2: Canary deploy (5% traffic) with short-window monitoring (1-min metrics + alerting): regression alerts (severity P1/P2), prompt drift detection, and user feedback capture.
4) Week 3: Expand to 25% if canary passes; otherwise rollback to previous model variant + immediate postmortem.

Key implementation items we need from Helix: canonical prompt exports, golden references for the eval harness, and SOC2 evidence for your data handling (legal/regulatory will want this).

Owners (proposed):
- CS lead: Marissa Cole (customer-facing quality reports / signoff)
- Implementation engineer: Dylan Brooks (eval harness integration + webhook endpoints)
- Success PM: Monica Patel (milestone tracking, runbooks)
- Redwood EM: Rishi Malhotra (overall delivery and escalation)

I'll attach a short checklist and propose the first sync Thur 5/23 10:00am PT. Also linking a working doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Helix-QMon

Next immediate asks for Helix: send canonical prompt exports and any existing regression thresholds by EOD Wed.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Quality monitoring & continuity plan for Helix Health integration

Thanks Rishi — plan looks good. Two additions from CS ops that we should bake in: 

- Synthetic prompt injection tests: run a small set of synthetic adversarial prompts (provided by Helix) during the canary window to validate safety filters.
- Thresholds: propose a three-tier threshold (green/amber/red) rather than single pass/fail so product can choose rollback triggers. Example: green >= 95% pass, amber 90–95% (manual review), red < 90% (auto-rollback).

I can assemble the runbook sections for weekly reports and the executive digest. I recommend Marissa take lead on the report template.

Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Looping in some concrete dates. I'm OK to drive the CS deliverables and weekly exec report. Proposed internal timeline:

- Fri 5/24: Run baseline eval pass (Dylan) and share variance band spreadsheet.
- Tue 5/28: Canary readiness review (all stakeholders) — checklists + safety test pass.
- Thu 5/30: Start 5% canary + daily report for 72 hours.

Dylan — can you confirm the eval harness integration checklist and whether you need a temporary API key or sample data drop? I attached the internal implementation checklist we use for integrations.

Subject: Re: Kickoff: Quality monitoring & continuity plan for Helix Health integration

Quick technical notes for the group:

- Eval harness integration: I'll need canonical prompt exports in JSONL and golden refs in CSV. Send via secure S3 or Drive link (pref S3).
- Endpoints: we'll provide a test webhook for real-time regression alerts and a dashboard feed for weekly reports.
- Canary metrics: token-level latency, model divergence score, clinical-safety-flag rate, and user-reported issue rate.
- Automatic rollback policy: trigger if red zone breached for >3 consecutive 10-min windows OR if safety-flag rate increases >150% relative to baseline.
- Fallback: requests will route to last-known-good model variant; state (KV cache) will be preserved for warm starts.

For SOC2 evidence — Asha, if you can send the requested doc list we will forward to our security team for a fast-track review.

Attachments referenced by customer earlier: Helix_QMon_Reqs.xlsx, Helix_SoC2_Request.txt

—Dylan
